descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Import și export angro
We’re a fast-growing company in the automotive industry, and we’re looking for an Analyst to help us scale up our product. In this job, "analyst" means way more than building dashboards. With AI tools doing the heavy lifting and you doing the thinking, you'll ship real features into production - not just report on them. 
 What you'll do 
 You'd be working directly with our Head of AI & Analytics. That means you help decide what gets built, not just how: 
 Build the platform the business runs on. Help us leverage the features and the backbone of our internal admin tools and our dealer-facing website. We go from a rough idea to production in weeks, not quarters. 
 Own our Vehicles’ catalogue. We want to have accurate vehicle data straight from the carmakers, so dealers see exactly the right car at exactly the right price. Bringing new cars to our platform will get faster than ever. 
 Extend our automations and agents. We run n8n workflows. You'd make them reliable and build the next ones. 
 Shape what we build. You'll talk to the CEO and to the sales and operations colleagues who use these tools very often. If you think there's a better way to solve their problem, say so - we'd rather change the plan than build the wrong thing well. 
 What we´re looking for 
 3+ years in analytics or in a data/ product related role 
 Strong SQL skills 
 Comfortable with messy external data: APIs, deduplication 
 You use AI coding tools daily and know where they get things wrong 
 You work from a rough spec and ask good questions instead of waiting 
 Real ownership: you'll have your own topics and run them end to end 
 You enjoy learning, including things you didn't sign up for. You have a curious mentality 
 Fluent in English 
 Nice to have: Automotive background, React and TypeScript knowledge 
 What We Offer: 
 25 days of vacation 
 Permanent employment contract
